This small plot is rented, only a quarter hectare, so I cannot spend much money on it. In Tigray the rains have been poor these past years and I have no irrigation here, so I must be careful. I will put a little manure from my animals and maybe a small bag of DAP if the cooperative brings it on time, but no pesticide — that is too costly for this plot. My wife and older children will help me weed and harvest, I do not need to hire anyone for such a small piece of land.
